newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-ELBIT SYSTEMS RATED BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-ELBIT SYSTEMS RATED BUY.

text.p: Sahar Securities & Investments initiated coverage of Israel's Elbit Systems Ltd with a buy recommendation, saying it stands to benefit from its spin-off last November from other Elbit companies.

"We do not view the doubling of the share price since the spin-off as extraordinary, but rather as a natural process whereby the share price was adapted to the prevalent ratios of similar companies worldwide and large companies on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange," Sahar said in a report.

"The spinning off from the various other Elbit companies only stands to benefit the company. The company's resources will once more be invested in its core operations, management will be more focused and the road will be paved for mergers and acquisitions," analyst Boaz Leviatan wrote.
Sahar estimated the company, a manufacturer of defence electronic systems, will earn $1.03 a share in 1997 and $1.12 in 1998 against $0.84 in 1996.
Sahar set a one-ear target price for the shares at $16.50-$18.00 on the basis of a price/earnings ratio of 16.

Sahar also cited reports of a possible public share offering in the United States. "In our opinion an additional public offering will contribute to increasing the liquidity of company shares and will increase exposure to foreign investors, thereby rendering it beneficial to the shareholders," the report said.
